notes: Historical presidential elections only; never 2026 midterm returns. Publisher compilation, not an independent official certification.
2017 Census geometry is not a current congressional map. Unmatched areas retain missing fill.
Alaska export reports state legislative districts, not counties/boroughs. Their IDs are deliberately not joined to borough geometry; district boundaries across years may differ.
Connecticut reporting units changed between years; only identical mapped units with both years support a swing comparison.
DC2024 is the sum of all eight published ward records before joining to district-wide county geometry.
